name: YouTube Video Data Extractor
description: No-code YouTube API and scraper. Extract video title, channel name and username, channel URL/ID, visibility, upload/publish dates, duration, views, likes, category, description, thumbnail, subtitles/transcript (when available), end screen recommendations, and age-restriction flag—no quotas or limits.
